YA7 – Yet Another 7-Zip GUI for macOS
Third-party software and source-code notice

This app includes 7-Zip 26.05 (7zz), Copyright (C) 1999–2026 Igor Pavlov.
7-Zip is invoked as a separate command-line program. Its executable from the
original upstream macOS archive has not been changed functionally; the packaged
copies are re-signed for macOS distribution. 7-Zip is not the author or publisher
of YA7. YA7 is an independent interface.

7-Zip licensing:
- GNU LGPL version 2.1 or, at your option, a later version, for most code.
- GNU LGPL with the unRAR license restriction for some code.
- BSD 3-clause and BSD 2-clause licenses for some code.

Read 7zip-License.txt for the upstream copyright notices, BSD texts and the
unRAR restriction. The complete LGPL 2.1 text is included as LGPL-2.1.txt.
These third-party license terms remain applicable independently of any YA7 terms.

Complete corresponding source:
The unchanged official 7-Zip 26.05 source archive is supplied with the containing
YA7 app as Contents/Resources/Legal/7z2605-src.tar.xz. It includes the source,
build files and upstream documentation. Source-Provenance.json records upstream
URLs and SHA-256 checksums. The containing app also supplies these sources for
its bundled Finder extensions and all copies of 7zz. Use the YA7 application
menu “Licenses and source code…” (“Lizenzen und Quellcode …” in German) to access this directory.

Upstream project: https://www.7-zip.org/
Release: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/tag/26.05
Source archive: https://github.com/ip7z/7zip/releases/download/26.05/7z2605-src.tar.xz

7-Zip may be used commercially subject to its license obligations. The unRAR
code must not be used to recreate the proprietary RAR compression algorithm.
YA7 creates ZIP and 7z archives; it does not create RAR archives.

The name “macOS” is used to describe platform compatibility. Apple is not the
publisher of YA7. Native interface symbols are provided by Apple frameworks;
the YA7 “Zip Seven” app icon is a separate generated design.
Apple-provided interface symbols are not relicensed by any YA7 source-code
license. Their use remains subject to Apple's terms for Apple-platform apps.
See https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/sf-symbols

YA7 project-owned code is licensed under GNU LGPL 2.1 or later.
See YA7-License.txt and YA7-Licensing.md. Corresponding YA7 source and build
scripts: https://github.com/BenThrottle85/YA7 (versioned release source archives).
